caption: The drawing is presented on a plain, beige background. In the center lower portion of the page, there are three objects arranged horizontally. The central object is a colored drawing of a ring with a blue, oval-shaped stone set in the middle, surrounded by a yellow and blue geometric border, and a golden band is visible on each side of the central setting. To the left of the colored ring is a line drawing (unfinished) of the same ring shown from the top view, while to the right is a line drawing of the ring in profile, showing the depth of the setting and the band. The unfinished drawings are done in fine pencil, with no color, just outlining the structure of the ring. At the very bottom left of the page, the name "M. FENGH" is written in small, uppercase letters. The remainder of the page is empty, with no additional objects or features.
title: Memorial Ring
